endings.name: The Architect Rises
endings.summary: Too much was forgotten: whatever answer is given at the choice fails, the shape Rhyla saw steps out of the Astral Expanse, and the sky fills with constellations no one has a name for.

endings.name: Remembered Whole
endings.summary: The party remembers who Izladar was, a Celestial Elf scholar; the Anchor holds his whole name, the voice finishes its sentence, and he chooses to stay. The dead witnesses stay dead.

endings.name: Dormant Again
endings.summary: The six pairs seal the wound by giving up the Twin-Soul Bond; the world is saved, and elves and dragons forget each other.

endings.name: The Rememberer
endings.summary: One pair, chosen by the player (keeper_pair), stays at the heart of the wound to hold the name for good; the seal holds and the world slowly remembers. Also the result of a failed attempt to speak his whole name.
